// Leaf: ?RegisterScripts@CScriptInfoManager@@IAEXXZ
// Retail: Fable.exe (TLC, VC7.1) @ 0x00CD52D0, 24,717 bytes, thiscall, plain `ret`, frame 0x18, one basic block (no branch).
// Name: Ego_r.pdb + FableWin.pdb ?RegisterScripts@CScriptInfoManager@@IAEXXZ (protected); the only caller is
//   CScriptInfoManager::Init 0x00CB5D80 (call at 0x00CB5E12, after its "Registering Scripts" progress text).
// What it does (479 statements, decoded from the retail call sites by tools/map.py; map/events.txt):
//   6 progress texts (NProgressDisplay::DisplayProgress(text, -1.0f, false, false));
//   5 master scripts: AddScript(CScriptInfo(name, 1, true, <Script>::Alloc, <Script>::StatGetMasterScriptDataAlloc()), "")
//     -- Q_SunnyvaleMaster, alextest, DanyalTestScripts, joss_test_scripts, Empty;
//   156 scripts, three statements each: CheckSectionIsNotAlreadyRegistered(section) (an empty body in retail, it only destroys
//     its by-value argument), AddScript(CScriptInfo(name, 1, false, <Script>::Alloc, <its master's data allocator or NULL>),
//     section), SetScriptActiveStatus(name, 0).  126 of them belong to Q_SunnyvaleMaster, 10 to Empty, 5 to
//     DanyalTestScripts, 2 to joss_test_scripts, 1 to alextest; 12 (the Global_* and Expression_* scripts) have no master data.
// Callees: CCharString(const char*, long) 0x0099EBF0, CCharString(const CCharString&) 0x0099EC30, ~CCharString 0x0099EAE0,

//   SetScriptActiveStatus 0x00CBFAB8 (__fastcall), and the addresses of 161 NScript::C<Name>Script::Alloc functions and of the

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- the recorder
enum { LOG_MAX = 4000, TEXT_MAX = 400000, KEY_MAX = 64 };
static char g_text[TEXT_MAX];
static int g_textUsed;
static const char* g_log[LOG_MAX];
static int g_logCount;
static bool g_overflow;
static char g_buf[4096];
static bool g_firstArg;
struct SState { long Value[4]; };                       // PostSavePosition, CoreQuestWaiting, BreakSiegeFinished, BodyGuardsInLimbo
static const char* const g_fieldName[4] = { "PostSavePosition", "CoreQuestWaiting", "BreakSiegeFinished", "BodyGuardsInLimbo" };
static SState g_seen;
struct SAnswer { long Stage; const char* Key; const char* Pattern; };   // Stage -1 = any stage; the last letter of Pattern repeats
static const SAnswer* g_answers;
static char g_key[KEY_MAX][96];
static int g_keyAsks[KEY_MAX];
static int g_keyCount;
static long g_keyStage;
static int g_tCalls, g_stopT, g_frames, g_framesAfterGame, g_framesToRunAfterGame, g_afterStop;
static bool g_stopped;

static SState CurrentState();
static long CurrentStage();
static void Put(const char* text)
{
    int n = (int)strlen(text) + 1;
    if (g_stopped) ++g_afterStop;
    if (g_logCount >= LOG_MAX || g_textUsed + n > TEXT_MAX) { g_overflow = true; return; }
    memcpy(g_text + g_textUsed, text, n);
    g_log[g_logCount++] = g_text + g_textUsed;
    g_textUsed += n;
}
static void FlushState()
{
    SState now = CurrentState();
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
        if (now.Value[i] != g_seen.Value[i]) {
            char line[64];
            sprintf(line, "%s=%ld", g_fieldName[i], now.Value[i]);
            Put(line);
            g_seen.Value[i] = now.Value[i];
        }
    }
}
static void Record(const char* text) { FlushState(); Put(text); }

public:
    CCharString() { Text[0] = 0; }

template <class T> class CArray {
public:
    CArray() : Count(0) { }
    void push_back(const T& item) { if (Count < 32) Items[Count++] = item; }
    T Items[32];
    int Count;
};

static void Begin(const char* name) { strcpy(g_buf, name); strcat(g_buf, "("); g_firstArg = true; }
static void Arg(const char* s) { if (!g_firstArg) strcat(g_buf, ","); g_firstArg = false; strcat(g_buf, s); }
static void Arg(const CCharString& s) { Arg(s.c_str()); }
static void Arg(const CScriptThing& t) { Arg(t.Name); }
static void Arg(long v) { char n[32]; sprintf(n, "%ld", v); Arg(n); }
static void Arg(int v) { Arg((long)v); }
static void Arg(unsigned long v) { Arg((long)v); }
static void Arg(bool v) { Arg(v ? "1" : "0"); }
static void Arg(float v) { char n[32]; sprintf(n, "%g", (double)v); Arg(n); }
static void Tell() { strcat(g_buf, ")"); Record(g_buf); }
// A question to the game: recorded like a call; the answer is the scenario's pattern for (stage, question), by default no / yes
// alternately, so that every plain wait loop runs exactly one frame.
static bool Ask()
{
    strcat(g_buf, ")");
    Record(g_buf);
    long stage = CurrentStage();
    if (stage != g_keyStage) { g_keyCount = 0; g_keyStage = stage; }
    int k = 0;
    while (k < g_keyCount && strcmp(g_key[k], g_buf) != 0) ++k;
    if (k == g_keyCount) {
        if (g_keyCount >= KEY_MAX || strlen(g_buf) >= sizeof(g_key[0])) { g_overflow = true; return true; }
        strcpy(g_key[g_keyCount], g_buf);
        g_keyAsks[g_keyCount++] = 0;
    }
    int n = g_keyAsks[k]++;
    for (const SAnswer* a = g_answers; a && a->Key; ++a) {
        if ((a->Stage == -1 || a->Stage == stage) && strcmp(a->Key, g_buf) == 0) {
            int len = (int)strlen(a->Pattern);
            return a->Pattern[n < len ? n : len - 1] == 'T';
        }
    }
    return (n & 1) != 0;
}
bool CScriptThing::IsAlive() const { Begin("IsAlive"); Arg(*this); return Ask(); }

// The model's thread: asked to terminate at the g_stopT-th check, or after g_framesToRunAfterGame frames of the finished game.
bool NScript::CGameflowScript::IsActiveThreadTerminating()
{
    Record("T");
    ++g_tCalls;
    if ((g_stopT && g_tCalls >= g_stopT) || (CurrentStage() == EGP_FINISHED_GAME && g_framesAfterGame >= g_framesToRunAfterGame)) g_stopped = true;
    return g_stopped;
}

static int StateField(const char* text, long* value)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
        int n = (int)strlen(g_fieldName[i]);
        if (strncmp(text, g_fieldName[i], n) == 0 && text[n] == '=') { sscanf(text + n + 1, "%ld", value); return i; }
    }
    return -1;
}
static int ExpectedCount() { int n = 0; while (g_expected[n].Text) ++n; return n; }
// Where retail enters for a stage value: just before the stage's own PostSavePosition store (the first statement of each case).
static int StageIndex(long stage)
{
    if (stage == EGP_WHITE_BALVERINE_KHG) stage = EGP_WHITE_BALVERINE_WITCHWOOD;   // retail's jump table sends 865 to the 870 label
    char line[64];
    sprintf(line, "PostSavePosition=%ld", stage);
    for (int i = 0; g_expected[i].Text; ++i) {
        if (stage == EGP_FINISHED_GAME ? g_expected[i].Region == 'L' : strcmp(g_expected[i].Text, line) == 0) return i;
    }
    return ExpectedCount();
}
static char g_why[512];
// The recorded run against the retail order: the two thread spawns, then everything from the stage's entry.  Every call must be
// the retail call, made with the four members holding what retail has stored by then.
static bool Matches(const SScenario& s, long stage)
{
    SState cur, act;
    cur.Value[0] = stage; cur.Value[1] = CQW_START; cur.Value[2] = 0; cur.Value[3] = 1;
    act = cur;
    int i = 0, calls = 0;
    for (int j = 0; j <= g_logCount; ++j) {
        const char* got = j < g_logCount ? g_log[j] : 0;
        long v;
        int f = got ? StateField(got, &v) : -1;
        if (f >= 0) { act.Value[f] = v; continue; }
        if (calls == 2) i = StageIndex(stage);
        for (;;) {
            const SExpected& e = g_expected[i];
            if (!e.Text) break;
            if (e.Region != ' ' && (e.Region == 'L' || !strchr(s.Active, e.Region))) { ++i; continue; }
            f = StateField(e.Text, &v);
            if (f < 0) break;
            cur.Value[f] = v;
            ++i;
        }
        const char* want = g_expected[i].Text;
        bool same = memcmp(&cur, &act, sizeof(cur)) == 0;
        if ((want || got) && (!want || !got || strcmp(want, got) != 0 || !same)) {
            sprintf(g_why, "stage %ld, call %d: retail has \"%.150s\", the script made \"%.150s\"%s", stage, calls, want ? want : "(nothing more)",
                got ? got : "(nothing more)", same ? "" : " with different member values");
            return false;
        }
        if (!same) { sprintf(g_why, "stage %ld: member values at the end differ", stage); return false; }
        if (!got) break;
        ++i;
        ++calls;
    }
    return true;
}
static int Count(const char* text) { int n = 0; for (int j = 0; j < g_logCount; ++j) if (strcmp(g_log[j], text) == 0) ++n; return n; }

static void KeepFullLog()
{
    memcpy(g_full, g_text, g_textUsed);
    for (int j = 0; j < g_logCount; ++j) g_fullLog[j] = g_full + (g_log[j] - g_text);

static void CheckScenario(const SScenario& s, const char* name)
{
    char what[640];
    // (1) the full run
    Run(s, EGP_INTRO, 0, 1);
    bool ok = Matches(s, EGP_INTRO) && !g_overflow;
    sprintf(what, "%s full run: %s", name, g_why);
    Check(ok, what);
    Check(g_end.Value[0] == EGP_FINISHED_GAME && g_end.Value[1] == 0 && g_end.Value[2] == 1 && g_end.Value[3] == 0, "state at the end of the game");
    Check(g_framesAfterGame == 1, "one frame after the game finished");
    KeepFullLog();
    int checks = g_tCalls;
    // (2) a start at every handled stage
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < sizeof(g_stages) / sizeof(g_stages[0]); ++k) {
        Run(s, g_stages[k], 0, 1);
        ok = Matches(s, g_stages[k]) && g_end.Value[0] == EGP_FINISHED_GAME;
        sprintf(what, "%s from a saved stage: %s", name, g_why);
        Check(ok, what);
    }
    // (4) a terminate request at the n-th check: the script stops there, having done exactly the calls before it
    for (int n = 1; n <= checks; ++n) {
        Run(s, EGP_INTRO, n, 1);
        ok = g_afterStop == 0 && g_tCalls == n && g_logCount <= g_fullCount && strcmp(g_log[g_logCount - 1], "T") == 0;
        for (int j = 0; ok && j < g_logCount; ++j) ok = strcmp(g_log[j], g_fullLog[j]) == 0;
        sprintf(what, "%s terminate request at check %d of %d", name, n, checks);
        Check(ok, what);
    }
}
